item.title: USDA raises U.S. soybean production forecast to 4.52 billion bushels
item.description: The August World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates (WASDE) raised the U.S. soybean yield to 53.6 bushels per acre, lifting production 2.1 percent from the July forecast.

item.title: Brazil wheat production lowered on dry Parana weather
item.description: USDA lowered Brazil wheat production to 8.9 million tonnes, down 6 percent, after persistent dryness in Parana and Rio Grande do Sul.
